# Each write of each act, refused one at a time on a fresh page. A block: the write and the
# answer; the requests that followed it; each run of text that appeared on the page (container,
# innermost element); the sheet; the page's message state; any rejection the page left unhandled.

## Sync from Core
# writes, in order: POST /api/payload-catalog/sync
### POST /api/payload-catalog/sync  ←  400 {"error"} (writeError)
    then: nothing
    new text: #pd-root div.pd-refusal: The catalog sync failed (400). Core may be unreachable.
    sheet: closed
    state: settingsError="The catalog sync failed (400). Core may be unreachable."
    unhandled rejection: none
### POST /api/payload-catalog/sync  ←  500, no body (chi Recoverer)
    then: nothing
    new text: #pd-root div.pd-refusal: The catalog sync failed (500). Core may be unreachable.
    sheet: closed
    state: settingsError="The catalog sync failed (500). Core may be unreachable."
    unhandled rejection: none
### POST /api/payload-catalog/sync  ←  no answer (fetch rejects: TypeError "Failed to fetch")
    then: nothing
    new text: none
    sheet: closed
    state: no message set
    unhandled rejection: TypeError: Failed to fetch (body data-pd-error set to its message)
### POST /api/payload-catalog/sync  ←  session lapsed (303 to /login, 200 text/html, for it and every admin call after)
    then: nothing
    new text: #pd-root div.pd-notice: Catalog synced from Core.
    sheet: closed
    state: settingsNotice="Catalog synced from Core."
    unhandled rejection: none
